source: &634 Apparently, the platform's controls are locked out while in motion. While this may have been an idea for safety, you can't help but think that a railing might have been a better start.
target: &634 看来，平台移动时，控制装置会锁定。也许这是为了安全，可你还是觉得，不如先装个护栏。

source: &637 All you can examine are the man's boots, the rest of his body remains pressed under the platform.
target: &637 只能检查那人的靴子，身体其他部分都压在平台下面。

source: &638 All that's left of the elevator's victim will only be of interest to the coroner.
target: &638 电梯受害者剩下的部分，只能引起法医的兴趣。

source: &639 Apparently, this man was a technician. You take his wrench.
target: &639 看来，他是个技术员。你拿走了他的扳手。

source: Picked up: Wrench
target: 已拾取：扳手

source: &640 Most of this man's body has been crushed by the elevator platform. You're not sure whether he fell first, but the eventual result has rendered that point moot.
target: &640 那人身体的大部分都被升降平台压碎了。你不确定，他是不是先摔下来，不过最终的结果，已经让这个问题无关紧要。

source: &641 The door at the top of the processor tower apparently leads to Central's logic centre. According to the lights above the door, the locks preventing your access are active.
target: &641 处理器塔顶的门，显然通向中枢的逻辑中心。从门上的指示灯来看，阻止你进入的锁仍然有效。

source: &642 The door at the top of the processor tower has surrendered to your efforts, and the locks have given way to allow you access.
target: &642 努力终于有了结果，处理器塔顶的门锁已经解除，你可以进入了。

source: &643 From where you are at the moment, you're unable to get to the door.
target: &643 从现在的位置，没法抵达那扇门。

source: &644 The secure elevator leads back down to Dr Vargas' office.
target: &644 那部受安保保护的电梯，通往下面瓦尔加斯博士的办公室。

source: &645 A coiled-up portable antenna, waiting to be deployed.
target: &645 一卷便携式天线，正等着展开架设。

source: The portable antenna has been deployed, lifted high enough to broadcast its signal.
target: 便携式天线已经架好，并升到了足以发射信号的高度。

source: Picked up: Grenade
target: 已拾取：手榴弹

source: &1455 It might be useful. Call it a hunch...
target: &1455 可能有用。就算是直觉吧……

source: &647 There's nothing else you can find on him that'd be of use.
target: &647 在他身上找不到别的有用东西。

source: &648 You're unable to reach him from here.
target: &648 从这里够不到他。

source: &649 The body of one of the remaining strike-team members. Apparently CEL officers managed to bring him down.
target: &649 一名剩余突击队成员的尸体。看来，CEL警员成功将他击倒了。

source: &650 The power conduit runs up the wall, further up into the tower. Judging by the glow, it's working as expected.
target: &650 供电线路沿墙向上，延伸进塔内更高处。从光芒来看，运作正常。

source: &651 The power conduit has been taken offline, though it sounds like it'll cycle back on shortly.
target: &651 供电线路已经离线，不过听起来，很快就会重新启动。

source: &652 The power conduits have been fully deactivated, cutting power to the server room's security.
target: &652 供电线路已全部停用，服务器房间的安保电源被切断。

source: &653 The power to the security system's already been deactivated. Better not mess with it any more.
target: &653 安保系统的电源已经切断，最好别再乱动。

source: &654 It's already in its offline cycle. All you can do now is try to deactivate its counterpart before it restarts.
target: &654 它已经进入离线周期。现在，只能赶在它重启前，把另一条也停掉。

source: &655 You're unable to reach the power conduit at this distance.
target: &655 距离太远，够不到供电线路。

source: &656 You make a grab for the power conduit, but the lift's movement carries you past its access point before you can disable it.
target: &656 你试着抓住供电线路，可还来不及停用，电梯就已经带你越过了操作位置。

source: &138 Power conduit Beta: Temporary shutdown.
target: &138 Beta供电线路：暂时关闭。

source: &139 Reactivation in: THIRTY seconds.
target: &139 重新启动倒计时：三十秒。

source: &42 Power conduit Beta: Temporary shutdown.
target: &42 Beta供电线路：暂时关闭。

source: &44 Reactivation in: THIRTY seconds.
target: &44 重新启动倒计时：三十秒。

source: &712 A control panel for calling the elevator platform.
target: &712 呼叫升降平台的控制面板。

source: &713 //ERROR - Hardware Failure[[Motive systems unusable due to mechanical obstruction.[[//ERR-1/101/2
target: &713 //错误——硬件故障[[机械阻挡，动力系统无法使用。[[//ERR-1/101/2

source: The antenna has already been deployed, and is apparently working as planned.
target: 天线已经架好，显然正按计划运行。

source: &734 The sturdy wrench prevents the platform's gears turning.
target: &734 结实的扳手卡住了平台齿轮，让它无法转动。

source: The door is resistant to physical damage - another way to open it will need to be found.
target: 这扇门能抵挡物理破坏，必须另找打开的办法。

source: &2026 I...wouldn't know where to start...
target: &2026 我……根本不知道该从哪里下手……

source: &1494 I'd better not touch it - I might risk harming Central.
target: &1494 最好别碰，可能会伤到中枢。

source: &723 Hardware's not my field. I'm going to need the Trance if I want to get into the machine.
target: &723 硬件不是我的领域。想进入这台机器，我得靠迷境。

source: &724 There's nowhere to make a connection out here.
target: &724 外面没有可以建立连接的地方。

source: &2027 I understand Central's organic component, but I've no idea what this is for.
target: &2027 中枢的有机部分，我明白，可这个是做什么的，完全不知道。

source: &1495 Central's inorganic framework...wow...
target: &1495 中枢的无机框架……哇……

source: &2028 You planning on asking for an autograph?
target: &2028 你还想请它签个名吗？

source: An elevator platform runs up the side of the core. The exposed gear strikes you as an accident waiting to happen.
target: 一座升降平台沿着核心侧面上下移动。外露的齿轮，让你觉得事故迟早会发生。

source: A control console, handling the communications fibre-line that runs into Central, has been hooked up to a portable antenna.
target: 一台控制台，管理着接入中枢的通信光纤，如今又接上了便携式天线。

source: The crushed technician appears to have been in the middle of his work, his tools are still nearby.
target: 被压死的技术员，似乎当时还在工作，工具仍散落在旁。

source: This door leads to the turbine room, controlling the power distribution amongst Central's innermost systems.
target: 这扇门通往涡轮室，那里控制着中枢内部系统之间的电力分配。

source: The lights are linked to the systems they control, though only as indicators - they have no influence over the locks themselves.
target: 灯与相应系统相连，但仅用来指示状态，不会影响门锁本身。

source: An array of LED lights shows the status of each of the three layers of security protecting this door.
target: 一组LED灯，显示着保护这扇门的三层安保状态。
